consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 74.5 mph steady (page figure; ≈120 km/h is our conversion), ~19 C (66-67 F ambient), road conditions not stated, wheel size not stated, battery-side (Nyland's registered/car-display consumption; page does not say explicitly) | Bjorn Nyland, Norway, 2024 Model 3 RWD LFP 60.9 kWh gross (Highland, same generation, pack and RWD layout as our 60/57 kWh LFP Premium-I; test is a 2024 car, our variant is 2026). Page states 4.03 mi/kWh = 154 Wh/km (1000 / (4.03 x 1.609344) = 154). Same test at 56 mph (90 km/h): 5.49 mi/kWh = 114 Wh/km. Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n323lX3NUKI, timestamp not known. Not the same market as ours (EU car), wheels unknown.

heat_pump.notes: EV Database RWD (Highland, LFP) lists heat pump standard equipment (European listing).

wheels.notes: Canadian Premium RWD: 463 km range with 18-inch wheels (the headline rating), 413 km with 19-inch. Page does not say which is standard; 18-inch inferred as standard from the headline range.
